issues_for_builder.title: Recurring listings bury the real answer in search_events
issues_for_builder.evidence: searchEvents in lib/tools.js treats a recurring row as happening every day between starts_on and ends_on (most run 2026-11-09..2027-02-28), orders by verified then starts_on ascending, and cuts at limit (default 8, max 25). Replaying that query read-only: Saturday Nov 14 + category nightlife = 61 rows; rows 1-28 are weekday happy hours, trivia, karaoke and open mics; 'Live DJ Weekends at Don Coqui' is row 33 (row 37 of 62 on Friday). Nov 12-30 nightlife = 82 rows, the first 21 are happy hours and trivia. Any category on Nov 25 = 69 rows with 'Thanksgiving Eve with Rubber Duckie Riot at Mason Jar' sorted near the end. Tool calls that hit this: girls-night t1 search_events({"category":"nightlife","start_date":"2026-11-14","end_date":"2026-11-14"}) -> 'I don't know of a real dance club in Bergen yet'; night-out-40s t3 search_events({"category":"nightlife","start_date":"2026-11-12","end_date":"2026-11-30","limit":15}) -> 'I haven't heard of anyone throwing a party this month' (80s Dance Party is Nov 21); phone t5 -> 'Nobody's announced a Thanksgiving Eve party'. It is also why Steel Wheel Tavern (row 3 or 4 every time) shows up in 14 of 29 conversations.
issues_for_builder.fix: Store days of week for recurring events (or parse recurrence_text) and drop rows that don't occur on a day in the window. Sort events dated inside the window first, then recurring ones. Put happy hour, trivia and karaoke rows last unless the keyword asks for them. Raise the default limit to about 20 and return how many rows were cut so the model knows to narrow.
issues_for_builder.impact: About 7 turns (phone t1, t3, t5; girls-night t1; night-out-40s t3; right-now t2, t3).

issues_for_builder.title: Every-word keyword matching and the events/places split return nothing for natural queries, and the agent then says 'nothing'
issues_for_builder.evidence: matchesKeyword needs every word of the keyword as a substring of one row. No venue row contains 'danc' at all (dancing is only on event rows), so search_places({"keyword":"DJ dancing","category":"nightlife"}) (night-out-40s t1, t2), search_places({"good_for":"groups","category":"nightlife","keyword":"dancing","limit":8}) (girls-night t1) and the production searches '[county/nightlife] DJ dancing', 'dancing DJ latin', 'dancing', 'hip hop R&B DJ' (phone t1, t2, t4) return 0 while Don Coqui sits in both tables. Other keywords that could never match one row: 'reggaeton latin DJ club', 'live music games arcade karaoke' (right-now t2), 'private room party dance floor', 'country music line dancing', 'live music DJ brunch', 'tea cafe lunch', 'dog friendly brewery patio', 'pottery painting art studio', 'metal punk', 'Giants watch party' (phone t9; the single word 'giants' shows they play Thursday Nov 12 and Sunday Nov 22, not Sunday Nov 15). Substring matching also over-matches: search_events({"keyword":"run","start_date":"2026-11-13","end_date":"2026-11-29"}) (new-in-town t2) returns 21 rows where 'run' is inside 'runs' or 'its run'; the 8 returned are happy hours, trivia and Dracula, 'Saddle River County parkrun' is row 10, and the agent said 'I don't know of a Bergen running club'. Spelling: 'hanukkah' misses 'Jewbilation: A Hanukah Variety Show' in Teaneck (cultural t1). The same opening text got Don Coqui on the branch (night-out-40s t1, events search with keyword) and nothing on production (phone t1).
issues_for_builder.fix: Score rows by how many keyword words match and rank them, instead of requiring all. Match on word starts and tags before free text. Add a small synonym map (dj/dance/dancing/club/party; hanukkah/chanukah/hanukah; run/5k/race). Either search events and places in one call or copy a venue's event tags onto the venue row. In the tool description say 'one or two words'. In the SYSTEM prompt: before saying you haven't heard of something, retry once with a single-word keyword in both tools, county-wide.
issues_for_builder.impact: About 7 turns (phone t1, t2, t4, t6; girls-night t1; new-in-town t2; right-now t2), overlapping with issue 1 on two of them, plus the wrong-day premise in phone t9.

issues_for_builder.title: No sense of 'nearby': exact-town filter, no distance ranking, places returned in table order
issues_for_builder.evidence: phone t6: the user named Fort Lee and Edgewater; searches were '[fort-lee/nightlife] DJ' and '[edgewater/any] rooftop', never Edgewater + DJ, so Don Coqui in Edgewater was missed. right-now t3 (near Englewood) led with Booyah! in Mahwah from search_events({"start_date":"2026-11-13","end_date":"2026-11-13","category":"nightlife","limit":8}) while Don Coqui (Edgewater) and The Basement (Bergenfield) are next door; t2 sent them to Westwood. toddler t3 search_places({"good_for":"toddlers","town":"Teaneck","limit":5}) can only return Teaneck or county-wide rows. teens ran search_places({"good_for":"teens","limit":6}), then limit 8, then 10: rows come back in table order (Ice House, six American Dream attractions, Wallington Lanes, Ramapo), so Humdingers, Monster Mini Golf, GOAT Climbing and NxGn laser tag (29 teen-tagged places in all) were never seen. budget-two got Mahwah, Hillsdale, Ridgewood and Oradell before anyone asked where they live.

issues_for_builder.title: The agent doesn't know what time it is and can't ask for 'on now'

issues_for_builder.title: Facts are saved unevenly: kid ages and towns missed, a visitor's tastes saved as the subscriber's, some borderline wording
issues_for_builder.evidence: teens: a 15-year-old is the whole conversation and facts after is []. girls-night, rain-plan, first-date, foodie-events: facts after [] despite stated tastes (dancing and lounges; hiking and active plans; new restaurants). Town is saved only for 'we're in / we live in / just moved to' (night-out-40s, budget-two, new-in-town, memory-carry); 'near teaneck', 'near ridgewood', 'coming from fair lawn and paramus' are dropped, and wife-40th stored it as a fact, remember({"items":[{"kind":"budget","fact":"party budget ~$100/head"},{"kind":"other","fact":"near River Edge"}]}), leaving town_slug null. senior-mom saved a visiting mother's tastes as the subscriber's: remember({"items":[{"kind":"interest","fact":"live music"},{"kind":"interest","fact":"gardens"},{"kind":"access","fact":"mom visiting can't walk far"}]}). Wording that edges toward what the prompt says not to store: {"kind":"access","fact":"wheelchair user"}, {"kind":"budget","fact":"tight budget, about $20 for two"}, {"kind":"other","fact":"planning wife's 40th in January"}. creative-night saved 'BYOB dinners' though they asked about BYOB classes.
issues_for_builder.fix: Prompt: save a kid's age the moment one is mentioned; treat 'near X' / 'from X' as the town and call update_profile; don't save one-off facts about a visitor, or label them ('for visiting mom'); phrase access and budget as needs ('step-free venues', 'free or cheap'), never as a condition or hardship; never store anyone's age or birthday. Consider a cheap end-of-conversation pass (lib/reflect.js already exists) to catch what the live turn missed.
issues_for_builder.impact: No outcome changes in this run; raises Personal fit in 11 conversations and decides the quality of Friday personal picks.
